# certloom_issuer (Resource)

An ACME certificate authority that deployments renew from. The directory URL and the terms-of-service decision are fixed; a different CA is a new issuer.

For CAs that require External Account Binding, set `eab_mode = "reusable"` with `eab_kid` and the write-only `eab_hmac_wo`. The HMAC is sealed on the server and never stored in plan or state; bump `eab_hmac_wo_version` to send a new one. `single_use` keys are managed with the certloom CLI.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "certloom_issuer" "letsencrypt" {
  name          = "letsencrypt"
  directory_url = "https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory"
  email         = "pki@example.com"
  agree_tos     = true
}

# A CA that requires External Account Binding. The HMAC is write-only and
# comes from an ephemeral variable, so it is in neither plan nor state.
variable "zerossl_eab_hmac" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

resource "certloom_issuer" "zerossl" {
  name                = "zerossl"
  directory_url       = "https://acme.zerossl.com/v2/DV90"
  email               = "pki@example.com"
  agree_tos           = true
  eab_mode            = "reusable"
  eab_kid             = "your-eab-kid"
  eab_hmac_wo         = var.zerossl_eab_hmac
  eab_hmac_wo_version = 1 # bump to send a new HMAC
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agree_tos` (Boolean) Must be `true`: records that you accept the CA's terms of service.
- `directory_url` (String) ACME directory URL (https).
- `name` (String) Unique issuer name.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `eab_hmac_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) EAB HMAC key from the CA (base64url). Write-only: never stored in plan or state.
- `eab_hmac_wo_version` (Number) Change this number to send `eab_kid` and `eab_hmac_wo` again, for example after the CA rotates the key.
- `eab_kid` (String) EAB key identifier from the CA. Required for `reusable`.
- `eab_mode` (String) External Account Binding: `none`, `reusable` or `single_use`.
- `email` (String) Contact address for new ACME accounts.
- `profile` (String) ACME certificate profile to request, if the CA offers profiles.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier assigned by certloom.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by id, as shown by the certloom CLI or API.
terraform import certloom_issuer.example <id>
```
